name: Algolia MCP
tagline: Managed search-as-a-service for AI agents — typo-tolerant, sub-50ms.
longDescription: The official Algolia MCP server. Lets your agent search any Algolia index, get results, and run autocomplete. Sub-50ms latency, typo tolerance, and ranking controls built in.

## What it is

The Algolia MCP server, by Algolia. Exposes Algolia's search API as MCP tools: search indices, get hits, manage rules, run analytics. Algolia is the canonical managed search engine — used by Stripe, Notion, and thousands of others.

## Why we recommend it

If you have a search-heavy app (docs, products, content), Algolia is the easiest to set up and the fastest. The MCP wrapper means your agent can query indices in real-time, useful for things like "find me docs that match X" or "search our knowledge base for Y".

## When to use it

- Doc search agents: agent finds the right doc page for a question
- E-commerce agents: agent finds products matching a description
- Content search: agent finds articles on a topic
- Analytics: agent pulls search analytics and identifies gaps
installInstructions:
1. Get an API key at https://dashboard.algolia.com/
2. Set: `ALGOLIA_APP_ID`, `ALGOLIA_ADMIN_API_KEY`
3. `npx -y @algolia/mcp-server`

**Pricing note:** Algolia has a free tier (10K records, 50K searches/mo). Paid plans start at $0.50/1K searches.
